passages.text:
Question regarding Facebook Groups that Target Migrants
[contact omitted] Anupama Rajaraman
To:[contact omitted]
Hi Shiva,
Saturday, March 20, 2021 at 6:09:54 PM Eastern Daylight Time
I have an informal inquiry for FB. As you probably have seen in the news, the U.S. Government is confronting
nprecedented levels of migrants attemptina to enter the U.S. in an irregular manner at the southwest border. The
lajority of these migrants are coming from Central America (Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador) and Mexicc
Unfortunately Facebook, among other social media tools, is a source of misinformation on U.S. policies and the
dangerous journey that vulnerable migrants undertake.
Here are two examples:
[access or personal detail omitted]
[access or personal detail omitted]
These FB groups are full of misinformation and inaccuracies about U.S. policies and, most importantly, these FB groups
encourage illicit activities -- specifically human smuggling and trafficking, on the part of "coyotes" and transnational
criminal groups. They also place vulnerable migrants at risk of exploitation and violence.
I'm curious (again this is not a formal question from the U.S. Government) if FB has policies governing groups like these.
Thanks!
Anu
Anu Raiaraman
Mission Director
USAID/Guatemala
